verdict.rationale: LangSmith's evaluation docs explicitly describe creating experiments by running datasets against different app/prompt/model versions and comparing them to 'benchmark performance, and catch regressions,' with pairwise comparison evaluators and experiment configuration for repeated runs. This directly matches the story of comparing eval runs side by side to catch regressions between versions. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of the actual side-by-side comparison UI in action, and no community corroboration specific to regression-catching workflows.
